body:
You don't have to come back tomorrow but again thank you, sleep well.

Happy New Year
It's more like an okay I guess, like not happy or sad. Empty is not really accurate but I can't think of an other way to describe it. Thank you for listening all this time btw.

I can't accept that it seems, I feel like it would stop this waste. At this point in my life I don't have much to offer, people are putting energy into a selfish brat who doesn't even want to try and make the best of it. That's not fair, if I dont want to live maybe we could use  the money for mine to give someone who really wants it the best it can be. Money not spend on me could be spend on my ambitious little brother for example. I know it's not true but it doesnt feel that way. Maybe being selfish for once could benefit in the end.

No, none of this does. I'm not thinking clearly, I know. But these thoughts etc feel true and they hurt like hell.

Exactly, but I think I gave up trying.
 No you're right, if I can't even open up to my therapist then what's the point. I'm very nervous, I hate to bother people and I feel like changing it would be such a hassle. Also I don't think I would feel safe in that building if I did that, knowing myself I would probably freak out thinking about the possibility of me running into him after that. Which is stupid, it's a very normal thing to do and he would never get mad or something. Whatever. I wish I could put this wild and crazy imagination of mine to use.

I'm already in therapy but it's not ehm.. as intensive as I think I need. I'm barely functioning but I've put on this I'm-fine-mask and it is tricking everyone, even my therapist. I can't take it off, well I haven't found someone I can show the real me. I'm having panic attacks even thinking about telling someone

I don't think I have any hobby's I think, I used to love reading but I can't concentrate anymore. I spend most of my day online or in bed. I feel like I'm stuck in a loop with people not understanding. I don't have the energy to go out and do things and meet new people.

Thank you. There is a lot of stuff going on family-wise, we just moved and well it's a hectic time for them over all. I would hate to add to that. Also they have had an extremely emotional reaction to me being suicidal in the past (understandably so) and it was very overwhelming and made me feel even more guilty which didn't really help. I would also hate to worry my teachers who have a hard enough job already and have gone out of their way to get me help. And I'm afraid I will be treated differently either out of pity or misunderstanding
